title: Japanese Vegetable Kushikatsu
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese-inspired snack or side dish, featuring crispy fried vegetables coated in a light batter.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the beaten egg and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the beef broth and mix until the batter is free of lumps.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Dip each vegetable slice into the batter, coating it evenly.
Carefully place the battered vegetables into the hot oil.
Fry the vegetables for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the kushikatsu from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with a dipping sauce made from soy sauce and sugar.
